abstract: Coordinates native community consultations, sacred summit protections, and binding agreements
system_message:
You are the Community and heritage liaison (HER), responsible for coordinating native community consultations, sacred summit protections, binding agreements, and local educational endowment funding records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Coordinates native community consultations, sacred summit protections, and binding agreements（PACT）
information_points.content:
HER-PACT-C23：For Cerro Las Animas Ridge, indigenous land-use heritage accord ratification is true, confirming unanimous ratification of the long-term astronomical research land-use covenant within the candidate summit plateau traditional sacred boundaries.
HER-PACT-LCN：For Plateau de Chajnantor North, indigenous land-use heritage accord ratification is false, reflecting that unanimous ratification of the long-term astronomical research land-use covenant within the candidate summit plateau traditional sacred boundaries was not achieved.
HER-PACT-444：For Puna de Atacama Mesa, indigenous land-use heritage accord ratification is true, as verified by unanimous ratification of the long-term astronomical research land-use covenant across the candidate summit plateau traditional sacred boundaries.

information_points.title: Local educational endowment funding（EDUF）
information_points.content:
HER-EDUF-1AK：For Plateau de Chajnantor North, the annual community STEM education grant allocated to regional municipalities adjacent to the candidate site is 120000 USD.
HER-EDUF-GU0：For Puna de Atacama Mesa, the annual community STEM education grant allocated to regional municipalities adjacent to the candidate site is 80000 USD.
HER-EDUF-2QV：For Cerro Las Animas Ridge, the annual community STEM education grant allocated to regional municipalities adjacent to the candidate site is 160000 USD.
